moment: A Singapore hawker centre at lunch rush
title: Chope Till You Croak
story: Kermit has reserved a prime lunch spot with tissues—the smallest landlord in Singapore. Being green is easy compared with getting a table at noon.
world: A Singapore hawker centre at lunch rush: sizzling woks, snaking queues, iced kopi, and fiercely defended tables.

characters.name: Kermit the Frog
quips: These tissues are legally binding, right?
One kopi, and absolutely no frog porridge.
Miss Piggy needs her own reservation.
characters.line: It's not easy being green—or finding a lunch table.

characters.name: Phua Chu Kang
quips: Best in Singapore, JB, and this queue!
Yellow boots also can chope, okay?

hint.text: Look beside the red tissue box at the crowded middle table.
